title: Meet the retailer energy savings obligation
what: As an electricity retailer, achieve the energy savings obligation (and, for tier 1 retailers, the priority household obligation) set for each compliance period by carrying out eligible energy efficiency activities, or, for tier 2 retailers, pay the energy savings contribution instead.

marks.reason: Retailers must fund and record energy savings activities each period.
The obligation adds a fixed compliance cost that weighs more on smaller retailers, who may pay a contribution instead.
